methodology.note: Scores are heuristic market-opportunity proxies, not revenue guarantees. They combine current playlist/use-case evidence, long-session suitability, repeatability, AI-generation fit, and competition intensity.

JP.label: 일본
JP.platformNote: YouTube/YouTube Music + Spotify/Apple Music/LINE MUSIC/Amazon ecosystem

recipes.label: KR 계절 감성 발라드 / Soft Pop
recipes.styleBlueprint: seasonal emotional soft-pop or ballad; warm piano/acoustic guitar; restrained drums; clear memorable hook; mature natural vocal; bridge contrast; fuller final without power-belt excess
recipes.lyricBlueprint: concrete seasonal memory, everyday scene, restrained emotion, simple singable Korean, one strong callback hook
recipes.marketRationale: Korean playlist/editorial behavior repeatedly favors seasonal emotional ballad themes; broad age reach but high competition.
recipes.risk: Very competitive. Thumbnail/title/theme differentiation matters as much as music quality.

recipes.label: KR 7080 감성 Original Old Pop
recipes.genreFamily: 70s/80s-inspired Soft Pop / Soft Rock / Soul Pop
recipes.styleBlueprint: original nostalgic soft pop with warm electric piano, clean guitar, gentle bass, restrained analog-era drum character, easy chorus, comfortable mid-register vocal
recipes.lyricBlueprint: memory, old radio, family, hometown, autumn, first snow, letters, coffee, train, ordinary love; avoid copying known oldies lyrics or melodies
recipes.marketRationale: Active Korean YouTube channels and recent uploads continue targeting 7080 nostalgia, cafe listening, rest and long-session playback.
recipes.risk: Must remain original; nostalgia is a mood/era trait, not imitation of specific legacy songs.

recipes.label: KR 카페 재즈 / Bossa / Cozy Instrumental
recipes.genreFamily: Cafe Jazz / Bossa Nova / Soft Swing / Lounge
recipes.styleBlueprint: warm piano, brushed drums, upright or rounded electric bass, clean jazz guitar, light bossa pulse, consistent low-fatigue dynamics
recipes.lyricBlueprint: instrumental preferred; if vocal, sparse non-distracting lines and short hooks
recipes.marketRationale: Cafe/restaurant/work BGM is an evergreen long-session use case and playlist boards continue to feature multi-hour jazz/cafe mixes.
recipes.risk: High supply; visual brand, seasonality and consistent audio quality are key.

recipes.label: KR Chill R&B / Neo-Soul / Mellow Hip-Hop
recipes.styleBlueprint: dry modern pocket, warm moving bass, Rhodes, restrained guitar, speech-rhythmic verse, melodic compact hook, intimate supported vocal
recipes.lyricBlueprint: urban everyday scenes, conversational intimacy, compact verse phrases, emotionally specific hooks
recipes.marketRationale: Current Korean R&B/Soul charts and chill-R&B playlist ecosystems show durable demand.
recipes.risk: Generic AI R&B is common; vocal phrasing identity is essential.

recipes.label: Universal Focus Lo-fi Jazzhop / Study Beats
recipes.styleBlueprint: steady low-distraction beat, soft jazz chords, muted drums, warm bass, minimal melodic motifs, no sudden transitions, long-loop compatibility
recipes.marketRationale: Study/focus lo-fi remains an established cross-market use case with strong repeat-session behavior.
recipes.risk: Very competitive globally; localization and visual identity help.

recipes.label: KR 수면 / Healing Piano / Ambient
recipes.styleBlueprint: very soft piano or pads, slow harmonic rhythm, low transient density, stable dynamics, natural ambience or water/rain texture, no startling peaks
recipes.marketRationale: YouTube explicitly identifies ambient channels for sleep, relaxation and concentration as massive long-session content; leading channels have billions of views.
recipes.risk: Medical/health claims should be avoided; market is large but crowded.

recipes.label: KR Deep House / Lounge / Night Drive
recipes.styleBlueprint: four-on-the-floor, warm sidechained bass, restrained synth plucks, airy pads, polished lounge groove, no festival drop, smooth breakdown/re-entry
recipes.lyricBlueprint: if vocal, sparse English hook lines with large instrumental space
recipes.marketRationale: Current playlist boards and long mixes continue to show deep-house/luxury/night-drive demand across cafe, drive and background contexts.
recipes.risk: Global competition is strong; mood packaging and visual branding are crucial.

recipes.label: JP Japanese Chill Pop / R&B 作業用BGM
recipes.genreFamily: Japanese Chill Pop / Mellow R&B / Lo-fi Pop
recipes.styleBlueprint: Japanese chill-pop first, mellow R&B tint, conversational native phrasing, compact verse, clean modern rhythm section, melodic but restrained chorus
recipes.lyricBlueprint: native contemporary Japanese, concrete room/train/night/cafe/work scenes, restrained emotional language, searchable short hook
recipes.marketRationale: Recent Japanese YouTube playlist examples explicitly package chill pop/R&B/lofi as 作業用BGM, sleep and night listening, including videos with substantial view counts.
recipes.risk: Japanese naturalness and title packaging matter; generic translated lyrics underperform.

recipes.label: JP Chill Rap / Neo-Soul / Tokyo Night
recipes.styleBlueprint: speech-forward Japanese chill rap, dry rim, moving bass, Rhodes or clean guitar, rhythmic verse, compact melodic hook, close supported vocal
recipes.lyricBlueprint: short mora phrases, urban relationship micro-scenes, conversational first-person, active rap pocket, controlled code-switch
recipes.marketRationale: Current Japanese playlist uploads use 日本語ラップ/チルラップ/作業用BGM/lofi/neosoul positioning, indicating a real but more focused audience than broad chill-pop.
recipes.risk: Requires strong vocal phrasing identity to avoid generic AI rap-pop.

recipes.label: JP Cafe Jazz / Bossa / 作業用BGM
recipes.styleBlueprint: warm piano, brushed kit, upright bass, soft jazz guitar, bossa pulse, smooth room tone, low-fatigue long-play arrangement
recipes.lyricBlueprint: instrumental preferred; if vocal, sparse and unobtrusive
recipes.marketRationale: 作業用・勉強用 jazz BGM remains a recurring Japanese playlist category and Spotify carries Japan Cafe BGM style playlists.
recipes.risk: Competition is high but long-session utility is excellent.

recipes.label: JP 睡眠用BGM / Healing Piano / Ambient
recipes.styleBlueprint: gentle piano, soft pads, low-frequency warmth, optional rain/water/forest ambience, extremely stable dynamics, no abrupt changes
recipes.marketRationale: Japanese playlist rankings feature multi-hour 睡眠用BGM, while dedicated sleep channels show large cumulative view counts.
recipes.risk: Avoid unsubstantiated health/medical claims in titles and descriptions.

recipes.label: JP City Pop / Retro Night Drive
recipes.styleBlueprint: original city-pop-inspired groove, clean guitar, electric piano, rounded bass, restrained brass/synth accents, night-drive polish, modern clean master
recipes.lyricBlueprint: urban night, train, bay road, convenience store, summer rain, late call; original hooks only
recipes.marketRationale: City-pop remains an evergreen Japanese/overseas nostalgia category used for drive, cafe and work playlists, though current competition is substantial.
recipes.risk: Avoid famous-artist soundalikes and direct retro-song mimicry.

recipes.label: JP Deep House / Luxury Lounge / Night Drive
recipes.styleBlueprint: clean deep-house groove, soft sidechain, warm sub-bass, minimal pluck, airy pads, elegant breakdown, smooth re-entry, long-mix continuity
recipes.lyricBlueprint: instrumental or sparse English hook only
recipes.marketRationale: Japanese playlist/ranking pages currently include deep-house and night-drive mixes as long background listening.
recipes.risk: Needs strong visual/mood positioning to stand out.

recipes.label: JP Showa-inspired Original Pop / Kayokyoku
recipes.styleBlueprint: original retro Japanese pop with clear melody, acoustic/electric guitar, piano, modest strings or brass, comfortable vocal register, modern-clean rather than copied vintage recording
recipes.lyricBlueprint: station, harbor, letter, season, hometown, ordinary adult love; concise natural Japanese
recipes.marketRationale: 昭和歌謡 continues to have cross-generational nostalgia interest, including younger-listener curation and live event activity.
recipes.risk: Niche and nostalgia-driven; originality is mandatory.

recipes.label: JP Acoustic J-Pop / Singer-Songwriter Story
recipes.styleBlueprint: acoustic or clean-electric core, modest drums, intimate native vocal, strong verse-to-chorus lyric payoff, memorable title hook
recipes.lyricBlueprint: specific contemporary Japanese scenes, restrained first-person storytelling, simple chorus phrase, no translationese
recipes.marketRationale: Broad Japanese listening demand but high competition; strongest when narrative and vocal identity are distinctive.
recipes.risk: High competition and higher dependence on lyric quality.

recipes.label: Global French Chanson / Paris Cafe
recipes.genreFamily: French Chanson / Cafe Pop / Musette-tinted Pop
recipes.styleBlueprint: French chanson first, warm piano/acoustic guitar, optional accordion used sparingly, conversational French vocal, elegant restrained rhythm section
recipes.lyricBlueprint: Parisian everyday detail, autumn cafe, station, river, letter, understated romance; native French phrasing
recipes.marketRationale: Smaller but differentiated cafe/European-aesthetic niche with lower competition than generic lo-fi or ballad.
recipes.risk: Smaller addressable audience; language quality matters.
